messages:
Sasha Kim: Quick evening check-in — what I did / blockers / today
Sasha Kim: Did: landed the microkernel change that fuses matmul+copy for KV updates; reduced one memcpy in the hot path and updated the CI unit tests. Ran a fast perf pass on my local RTX and saw a 6% p50 win on small batches.
Sasha Kim: Blocker: CI is failing on a quantized path when seq_len > 1024 (kernel_assert in qk kernel). Also seeing some p99 tail spikes on small-microbatch workloads due to KV eviction thrashing.
Kevin Patel: Can you paste the failing log? I can try to repro on my workstation. :eyes:
Sasha Kim: Pasted minimal repro and command below:
```
# repro command
python -m perf.run --model redwood-small --seq 128 --microbatch 4 --use-quant --seed 42
# failing snippet
E kernel_assert at src/attn_q.c:412: mismatch in qk_accum
```
Maria Lopez: I repro'd the kernel_assert locally with the same args. Looks like rtol drift introduced by the reorder patch in attn_q. I'll bisect that commit tonight to confirm.
Jae Park: Heads-up — I pushed an eviction-tuning PR (#4287) that bumps hot_set pruning from 0.2 -> 0.35 and delays eviction by 50ms for newly-hot entries. It helped tail in our dogfood runs. cc @Sasha Kim for validation.
Sasha Kim: Thanks Jae — I'm going to run a comparative sweep: ded pool 10k requests (p50/p95/p99) + microbench runs. Local commands I plan to run:
``
tools/bench --target=ded --config=kv-compare.yaml --runs=3 --trace=kv_eviction
``
benchbot: bench results uploaded: https://redwood.internal/bench/183000/kv-evict-compare — p99 improved ~18% with Jae's PR (nightly sampler).
Kevin Patel: Nice improvement :tada: Can you attach the flamegraph and the raw CSV? I'll skim for CPU scheduling artifacts. Also I left a review comment on the microkernel PR — missing an edge-case test.
Sasha Kim: Will add the edge-case test today. Blocker: need access to a quantized CUDA container matching CI (image sha mismatch). I opened an infra ticket but onboarding is pending.
Maria Lopez: I have a container snapshot that matches CI. DM me and I'll share the image tag.
Sasha Kim: Will do. Today: add the failing unit test (cover seq_len 2048 boundary), run 3 bench runs with and without PR #4287, validate Jae's eviction tweak on the dedicated pool, and post updated microkernel PR for review. If infra gives me the container I'll repro the quant failure and push a hotfix. :+1:
Kevin Patel: I'll take the review once tests are green. Ping me for pairing if the quant repro looks flaky.
Jae Park: One note — if we see persistent regressions on long-seq paths, we should gate quantized kernels behind a fallback flag so we can roll back quickly for seq>2048.
Sasha Kim: Good call. I'll add an env flag REDW_QUANT_FALLBACK_LONGSEQ=1 for testing and keep it off by default.
deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled 2026-03-17T02:00Z for PR #4287 (eviction-tuning).
Sasha Kim: Ack deploy-bot — will validate metrics after canary. Thanks team, ping me if you want to pair on the quant repro or bench analysis. :eyes:
